PokeCon Rust runtime

Usage: pokecon [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --ui <UI>
          Selects the UI lifecycle mode

          Possible values:
          - web
          - desktop
          - gpui:    Native `GPUI` `PoC` shell sharing the single backend lifecycle
          
          [default: web]

      --exit-after-startup
          Exit successfully after the runtime boundaries have started

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')

  -V, --version
          Print version
